name: Watson Bio Chimney-well 196-96FIS 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: WATSON Bio Lab chimney-well 96 well microplate, flat bottom, individual (free-standing chimney) wells in a moat, polystyrene, clear, with lid, sterile, 50 individually packaged. 196-96FIS; the dimensions chart lists 197-96CIPS (with lid) under the same row. Not the same mould as the flat-top 96 well plates 196-96FS / 195-96F (380 uL, different well diameter and depth). Every dimension is printed in the WATSON 'Dimensions Chart for Microplates' (EN_MicroPlate_DimensionTable.pdf, created 2024-04-11, no revision printed), row '96 well flat bottom, Individual well [capacity of a well: 450 uL]', all in mm: plate length 127.7, width 85.4, height 14.6, lid + plate height 17.5, well depth 11.6, bottom surface height 1.6 (underside of the well bottom above the resting plane: bottom_elevation), A1 centre 11.1 from the top edge and 14.2 from the left edge, well spacing 9.0, well bottom diameter 7.0 and well (top) diameter 7.0 (a straight well, so no diameter_top), flange height 7.6 (skirt_height; the chart's section draws it as the height of the outer step), well bottom thickness 1.5. floor_height 3.1 mm is derived, 1.6 + 1.5. The chart's own numbers disagree by 0.1 mm: plate height minus floor height gives 11.5 mm against the printed well depth of 11.6 mm; the printed depth is used. The product page's well figure gives the same 7.0 mm diameter and 11.6 mm depth and a bottom area of 0.4 cm^2 (d = 7.1 mm). 450 uL is the vendor's capacity per well (pi x 3.5^2 x 11.6 = 446 uL), not a recommended working volume, so no working volume is recorded. The product page gives the size as 127.7 x 85.4 x 17.5 mm with lid. The skirt outline, skirt thickness and the corner shape are not on the chart, which is a generic diagram drawn for a 12 well plate, so they are left to the standard. Units in meters.
